Comparing the two hub-sector affine minima yields odd x=1 and even x=n/(n−2), plus saturation x=n, with all ties and endpoints accounted for, and spin reversal extends to h<0. Independent exact brute over all n+1 labelled spins n4..10 at rational fields and boundary neighbors reproduced each energy and multiplicity; infinite-family result uses the ring lemma.

final_claim: For homogeneous spin-1/2 classical antiferromagnetic Ising wheels W_(n+1), n≥4, in uniform longitudinal field: odd rims n≥5 first cross at |h|=J with L_n+2n ground states and then saturate at nJ; even n first cross at |h|=nJ/(n−2) with exactly 3 states and saturate at nJ. Exact piecewise ground energy and all-field ground-state multiplicities hold, giving critical odd entropy per spin log φ versus zero even.
limitations: Wheel n≥4, binary Ising spins, equal positive antiferromagnetic spoke/rim J, homogeneous longitudinal field.
